meta.name: Duniya Ki Thain Thain
meta.description: In Shaktipur, aspiring shooter Vikas's passionate romance with politician's daughter Vaishnavi spirals into crime and betrayal. Five years later, their worlds collide as gangster and IPS officer.

videos.title: Nishana
videos.overview: Vikas, a talented shooter, aspires representing India at the Olympics despite mounting family financial struggles. As political forces draw him into dangerous territory, his growing fascination with Vaishnavi, the privileged daughter of MLA Brijhbhan Chaturvedi, puts him at risk. With an enemy plotting to abduct her, vikas's greatest strength could become his greatest danger.

videos.title: Dariyai Ghoda
videos.overview: When armed goons attack Vaishnavi Chaturvedi, she is rescued by Vikas Kumar, a fearless and skilled shooter. Impressed by his courage, her family hires him to train her in shooting and self-defence. But the connection to the rival Thakur family threatens to reignite Shaktipur’s bitter political feud.

videos.title: Birthday
videos.overview: As Vikas trains Vaishnavi, she grows more confident and their bond deepens, worrying both families. Amid rising tensions between the Chaturvedis and Thakurs, Vikas surprises Vaishnavi with a late-night ride to celebrate her birthday. Their growing intimacy, however, does not go unnoticed.

videos.title: Sweetheart Mil Gaya
videos.overview: Vikas and Vaishnavi confess their love, but their relationship draws the attention of powerful forces. Pressured to stay away from her, Vikas is forced to choose between love and family. When Vaishnavi discovers he may be in danger, she races against time to reach him, risking everything for their future

videos.title: Gawahi
videos.overview: When Vaishnavi is kidnapped, Vikas risks everything to rescue her, triggering a deadly shootout. Arrested and accused of murder, he faces a high-profile trial. Vaishnavi shocks everyone with her testimony against him, leaving Vikas and his family devastated and raising questions about her sudden betrayal.

videos.title: Maa
videos.overview: Sentenced to life imprisonment, Vikas struggles to understand Vaishnavi’s testimony as his family fights to reopen the case. Meanwhile, a conspiracy threatens his loved ones, and Vaishnavi faces appreciation from her own family. As Vikas is taken into custody, it becomes clear that powerful forces may be manipulating events behind the scenes.

videos.title: Khabardaar
videos.overview: As Vikas struggles with life imprisonment, Bhairav consolidates his power by manipulating Shaktipur’s political rivalries. Meanwhile, Vaishnavi begins university and meets Akash. Inside prison, Vikas encounters an inmate with a bitter history involving the Chaturvedis, adding another layer to the town’s dangerous web of revenge.

videos.title: Tabahi
videos.overview: A prison visit on Raksha Bandhan brings Vikas face-to-face with painful memories of his family. As violence erupts inside prison, Bhairav fuels Vikas’s growing desire for revenge. With crime escalating in Shaktipur and political tensions rising, Vikas and his allies begin planning their next move against the powerful Chaturvedi family.

videos.title: Vicky Kon Hai ?
videos.overview: As SP Vaishnavi cracks down on Shaktipur’s mafia, Bhairav hints at secrets surrounding her family. Meanwhile, Vicky’s thirst for revenge against Brijbhan intensifies. Reconnecting with old allies, he targets Sahil through a humiliating public campaign, escalating the bitter feud between the underworld and the powerful Chaturvedis.

videos.title: Hisaab Barabar
videos.overview: Vicky makes his presence felt in Shaktipur, openly challenging the powerful Chaturvedi family. As SP Vaishnavi pursues him, Vicky’s revenge escalates, forcing her to confront the growing threat to her family and setting the stage for a dangerous face-off.

videos.title: Khatra
videos.overview: Vicky makes his presence felt in Shaktipur, openly challenging the powerful Chaturvedi family. As SP Vaishnavi pursues him, Vicky’s revenge escalates, forcing her to confront the growing threat to her family and setting the stage for a dangerous face-off.

videos.title: Baap Ya Wardi ?
videos.overview: SP Vaishnavi’s raid on Bhairav’s warehouse sparks a violent confrontation, escalating the conflict with Vicky. As Sahil threatens Vicky’s family, Vicky moves his loved ones to safety. Meanwhile, Vaishnavi uncovers a weapons-smuggling operation linked to Vicky, setting up another dangerous showdown.

videos.title: Faraar
videos.overview: Sahil’s escape from an illegal weapons-smuggling case sparks a media storm and intensifies the feud between Vikas and the Chaturvedis. As Vikas’s gang closes in, family loyalties and past betrayals complicate the chase, leading to a dangerous confrontation fuelled by Vikas’s desire for revenge.

videos.title: Raid
videos.overview: Vikas and Vaishnavi’s bitter rivalry takes a dangerous turn when she is arrested after ₹25 lakh is found in her bag. Accused of corruption, Vaishnavi faces a legal battle, while Vikas becomes a key witness. As conflicting accounts emerge, questions arise over whether she is guilty or the victim of a revenge-driven conspiracy

videos.title: Badla
videos.overview: As new evidence emerges in Vaishnavi’s bribery case, Vikas and Vaishnavi attempt to end their bitter feud. But Bhairav’s manipulation pushes Ankit towards a deadly confrontation with Sahil. When Vikas unexpectedly spares Sahil, the cycle of revenge takes another turn, threatening to ignite an all-out war between the rival families.
